rubric: The scenario names a label the app no longer uses.

criteria.cause: the scenario or the way it was driven is wrong; the app behaves as intended

reading.why: The note says the page has an Export button that works and the scenario was written against the old label: the app behaves as intended and the scenario is wrong.

ruledOut.question: cause
ruledOut.label: product_bug
ruledOut.why: The scenario is wrong and the app is right. It is not: the app does not do what the scenario asks.

ruledOut.question: cause
ruledOut.label: env_flake
ruledOut.why: The scenario is wrong and the app is right. It is not: the target, the dev server, the browser or a tool failed; the scenario was never really tried.
